states.meaning: 7-bit global branch history register

states.name: pht
states.meaning: 128-entry table of 2-bit saturating counters indexed by xor of pc[6:0] and ghr

rules.spec_quote: When a branch prediction is requested (predict_valid = 1) for a given pc, the branch predictor produces the predicted branch direction and state of the branch history register used to make the prediction.

When a branch prediction is requested (predict_valid = 1) for a given pc, the branch predictor produces the predicted branch direction and state of the branch history register used to make the prediction.
The branch history register is then updated (at the next positive clock edge) for the predicted branch.
Update the pattern history table (PHT) to train the branch predictor to predict this branch more accurately next time.
if the branch being trained is mispredicted, also recover the branch history register to the state immediately after the mispredicting branch completes execution.
When this happens, training takes precedence, because the branch being predicted will be discarded anyway.
the prediction sees the PHT state before training because training only modifies the PHT at the next positive clock edge.
Reset is asynchronous active-high.

before.mid: Optional mid input changes occur AFTER sampling, before the other edge, and are carried to the start of the next row.

uncertain.note: Spec does not explicitly define output values when predict_valid is 0; assumed held/zero.
candidates: predict_taken and predict_history retain previous values
predict_taken and predict_history are zero when predict_valid is 0
